noah: Quick follow-up from yesterday's cache hotkey postmortem. We need a short runbook triage section + owners for the action items.

emma: Can you paste the proposed steps?

noah: Triage to add to runbook: 1) Verify signals: PromQL for evictions and p95 latency, redis INFO memory. 2) Short mitigation: flip noncritical traffic to read-only cache tier or mid-tier fallback. 3) Fix: identify hot prefixes, apply prefix TTLs or sharding, roll config via canary. 4) Postmortem actions: add synthetic hotkey test to CI and update escalation thresholds.

noah: Commands to include (copy into cookbook):
```bash
# promql: evictions rate
sum(rate(redis_evicted_keys_total[1m]))
# redis mem + evictions
redis-cli INFO memory | egrep "used_memory_human|evicted_keys"
# approximate top keys (scan + memory usage)
redis-cli --scan | xargs -n1 -P8 redis-cli MEMORY USAGE | sort -nr | head -n 25
# check k8s pod restarts and OOMs
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=cache -o wide; kubectl describe pod <pod> | egrep "OOMKilled|RestartCount"
```

chris: I'll own the CI synthetic test and a small load job for staging. ETA Tue.

emma: I'll open the cookbook PR with the triage flow, PromQL, and canary guidance (5% traffic, 30m). ETA Mon EOD.

zara: Escalation change: add explicit condition to page infra lead when evicted_keys > 0 AND p95 latency > 250ms for >5m. I'll add contact matrix and Slack templates. ETA Wed.

ops-bot: Reminder queued: follow-up check-in in 7 days (1781839367) for thread 1781234567.

noah: Owner summary: cookbook PR = emma (due 2026-04-06), CI test = chris (due 2026-04-07), escalation matrix = zara (due 2026-04-08). I'll file the follow-ups in the postmortem tracker after PRs land. Thanks.
